rationale: C05 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. It uses the same compact operative machinery: identification of particular provisions in title 10, immediate suspension by “are hereby suspended,” and the distinctive expiration formula tied to June 30 of the fiscal year following the end of the December 16, 1950 national emergency. C16 and C02 are also strong members of the same drafting pattern, but C05 is the closest overall combination of title-10 framing, officer-personnel subject matter, and nearly identical operative syntax.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The provisions of section 5231 (b) of title 10 of the United States Code ... are hereby suspended until June 30 of the fiscal year following that in which the national emergency proclaimed by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of December 16, 1950, shall end.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the provisions of section 5764 (a) of title 10 of the United States Code are hereby suspended until June 30 of the fiscal year following that in which the national emergency proclaimed by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of December 16, 1950, shall end.
shared_material.explanation: This is a nearly verbatim operative sentence template, with the statutory section and affected class of naval officers changed.
